e: First attested in the early 18th century, originally Scots, probably onomatopoeic.
q: On opening the little door, two hairy monsters flew at my throat, bearing me down, and extinguishing the light; while a mingled guffaw from Heathcliff and Hareton put the copestone on my rage and humiliation.
